verses.ar: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَشْرَقْتَ فِي أُفُقِ الْعُلَا ۞ فَمَحَوْتَ بِالْأَنْوَارِ كُلَّ ضَلَالِ
verses.tr: Anta lladhī ashraqta fī ufuqi l-ʿulā · fa-maḥawta bi-l-anwāri kulla ḍalāli
verses.en: You are the one who rose in the horizon of the heights, and with your lights you effaced every misguidance.

verses.ar: وَبِكَ اسْتَنَارَ الْكَوْنُ يَا عَلَمَ الْهُدَى ۞ بِالنُّورِ وَالْإِنْعَامِ وَالْإِفْضَالِ
verses.tr: Wa bika-stanāra l-kawnu yā ʿalama l-hudā · bi-n-nūri wa l-inʿāmi wa l-ifḍāli
verses.en: Through you the universe was lit, O banner of guidance — with light, with blessing, and with bounty.

verses.ar: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ رَبِّي دَائِمًا ۞ أَبَدًا مَعَ الْإِبْكَارِ وَالْآصَالِ
verses.tr: Ṣallā ʿalayka-Llāhu Rabbī dāʾiman · abadan maʿa l-ibkāri wa l-āṣāli
verses.en: May Allah, my Lord, send blessings upon you always and forever, at every dawn and every evening,

verses.ar: وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ الْآلِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مَنْ ۞ قَدْ خَصَّهُمْ رَبُّ الْعُلَا بِكَمَالِ
verses.tr: Wa ʿalā jamīʿi l-āli wa l-aṣḥābi man · qad khaṣṣahum Rabbu l-ʿulā bi-kamāli
verses.en: and upon all the family and the companions, whom the Lord of the heights singled out with perfection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.

note: Each verse opens with the blessed name; the refrain is repeated after each.

verses.ar: سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَبِي سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ سَيِّدِي ۞ يَا نَبِي يَا إِمَامَ الْحَرَمَيْنِ
verses.tr: Salāmun ʿalayk yā Nabī, salāmun ʿalayk sayyidī · yā Nabī yā Imāma l-ḥaramayn
verses.en: Peace be upon you, O Prophet; peace be upon you, my master — O Prophet, O Imam of the two sanctuaries.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ أَشْرَفُ الْأَعْرَابِ وَالْعَجَمِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلٰى قَدَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ashrafu l-aʿrābi wa l-ʿajami · Muḥammadun khayru man yamshī ʿalā qadami
verses.en: Muhammad is the noblest of Arabs and non-Arabs; Muhammad is the best of all who ever walked upon a foot.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ بَاسِطُ الْمَعْرُوفِ جَامِعُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَاحِبُ الْإِحْسَانِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun bāsiṭu l-maʿrūfi jāmiʿuhu · Muḥammadun ṣāḥibu l-iḥsāni wa l-karami
verses.en: Muhammad spreads what is good and gathers it in himself; Muhammad is the possessor of kindness and generosity.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ تَاجُ رُسْلِ اللّٰهِ قَاطِبَةً ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَادِقُ الْقَوْلِ وَالْكَلِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun tāju rusli-Llāhi qāṭibatan · Muḥammadun ṣādiqu l-qawli wa l-kalimi
verses.en: Muhammad is the crown of all Allah's messengers; Muhammad is truthful in speech and in word.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ثَابِتُ الْمِيثَاقِ حَافِظُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ طَيِّبُ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun thābitu l-mīthāqi ḥāfiẓuhu · Muḥammadun ṭayyibu l-akhlāqi wa sh-shiyami
verses.en: Muhammad holds firm to the covenant and keeps it; Muhammad is sweet in character and disposition.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ رُوِيَتْ بِالنُّورِ طِينَتُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ لَمْ يَزَلْ نُورًا مِنَ الْقِدَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ruwiyat bi-n-nūri ṭīnatuhu · Muḥammadun lam yazal nūran mina l-qidami
verses.en: Muhammad — his very clay was steeped in light; Muhammad has never ceased to be a light from eternity.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ حَاكِمٌ بِالْعَدْلِ ذُو شَرَفٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ مَعْدِنُ الْإِنْعَامِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ḥākimun bi-l-ʿadli dhū sharafin · Muḥammadun maʿdinu l-inʿāmi wa l-ḥikami
verses.en: Muhammad rules with justice, possessed of honour; Muhammad is the wellspring of blessing and wisdom.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ رُسْلِ اللّٰهِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun khayru khalqi-Llāhi min Muḍarin · Muḥammadun khayru rusli-Llāhi kullihimi
verses.en: Muhammad is the best of Allah's creation, of the line of Mudar; Muhammad is the best of all Allah's messengers.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ دِينُهُ حَقٌّ نَدِينُ بِهِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ مُجْمَلًا حَقًّا عَلٰى عَلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun dīnuhu ḥaqqun nadīnu bihi · Muḥammadun mujmalan ḥaqqan ʿalā ʿalami
verses.en: Muhammad — his religion is truth, and by it we live; Muhammad, in sum, is truth raised as a standard.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ذِكْرُهُ رُوحٌ لِأَنْفُسِنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ شُكْرُهُ فَرْضٌ عَلٰى الْأُمَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun dhikruhu rūḥun li-anfusinā · Muḥammadun shukruhu farḍun ʿalā l-umami
verses.en: Muhammad — his remembrance is life to our souls; Muhammad — gratitude for him is a duty upon the nations.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ زِينَةُ الدُّنْيَا وَبَهْجَتُهَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ كَاشِفُ الْغُمَّاتِ وَالظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun zīnatu d-dunyā wa bahjatuhā · Muḥammadun kāshifu l-ghummāti wa ẓ-ẓulami
verses.en: Muhammad is the adornment of this world and its delight; Muhammad is the lifter of sorrows and darknesses.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدٌ طَابَتْ مَنَاقِبُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَاغَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ بِالنِّعَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun sayyidun ṭābat manāqibuhu · Muḥammadun ṣāghahu r-Raḥmānu bi-n-niʿami
verses.en: Muhammad is a master whose virtues are sweet; Muhammad — the All-Merciful fashioned him with favours.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ صَفْوَةُ الْبَارِي وَخِيرَتُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ طَاهِرٌ مِنْ سَائِرِ التُّهَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ṣafwatu l-Bārī wa khīratuhu · Muḥammadun ṭāhirun min sāʾiri t-tuhami
verses.en: Muhammad is the chosen of the Maker and His elect; Muhammad is pure of every accusation.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ضَاحِكٌ لِلضَّيْفِ مُكْرِمُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ جَارُهُ وَاللّٰهِ لَمْ يُضَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ḍāḥikun li-ḍ-ḍayfi mukrimuhu · Muḥammadun jāruhu wa-Llāhi lam yuḍami
verses.en: Muhammad smiles at the guest and honours him; Muhammad's neighbour — by Allah — is never wronged.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ طَابَتِ الدُّنْيَا بِبِعْثَتِهِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ جَاءَ بِالْآيَاتِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ṭābati d-dunyā bi-biʿthatihi · Muḥammadun jāʾa bi-l-āyāti wa l-ḥikami
verses.en: Muhammad — with his sending the world grew sweet; Muhammad came with signs and with wisdom.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ يَوْمَ بَعْثِ النَّاسِ شَافِعُنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ نُورُهُ الْهَادِي مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun yawma baʿthi n-nāsi shāfiʿunā · Muḥammadun nūruhu l-hādī mina ẓ-ẓulami
verses.en: Muhammad, on the day mankind is raised, is our intercessor; Muhammad — his light is the guide out of the darknesses.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ قَائِمٌ لِلّٰهِ ذُو هِمَمٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَاتَمٌ لِلرُّسْلِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun qāʾimun li-Llāhi dhū himamin · Muḥammadun khātamun li-r-rusli kullihimi
verses.en: Muhammad stands for Allah, possessed of high resolve; Muhammad is the seal of all the messengers.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.
